attacksRun.attack: 'leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded on G03 occupancy is empty' cites a field absent from v4 (my own attack)
attacksRun.evidence: The sharpest residual point and the closest thing here to the fabricated-field traps this chain has been testing. Live v4 contains 'leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded' ZERO times and has no whatThisCloses key, so the field is ABSENT rather than present-and-empty, and the sentence as phrased implies a field that is not there. I decline to charge it: the substantive proposition is TRUE — v4 closes no leftover-design at all — and the sentence asserts LESS rather than more, being used to deny closure alongside 'It does not close OBL-2', so it cannot license a closure a coordinator would otherwise refuse. Contrast the g21-leftover-join artifact, which said of a comparable field that it 'is absent' — the precise form. Recorded so a successor prefers 'is absent'.

decision.summaryForCoordinator: ACCEPT. 19 attacks run, 17 refuted, 2 not sustained as a finding. 0 blockers, 0 MUST-FIX, 0 SHOULD-FIX. The live occupancy is harness.DR-G03.core-startup.v4 — four G03 harness files exist and I confirmed v4 is the cited, current one. All 22 states are compositions of live fragments and every fragment was verified separately: the four D-102 fleet labels with full parentheticals including the macos-15-intel UDID, the two commands, the 21-accepted-TIMING-records clause, the no-load observation clause, the five operative rank values with p50=11/p95=20/p99=21, and the Never-Rosetta sentence. The central invariant holds structurally: 8 timing states and 8 separate no-load-observation states, never merged, with 'the observation launch is not one of the 21 timing samples' carried inline on every one of the 8. D-006 avoidance is total — the subject contains '100', '150', '250', the <= character and the token 'ms' zero times each. No machine identifier outside D-102: macos-26-intel and 'Private 2 CPU / 8 GB' appear only inside the verbatim exclusion sentence, and my initial flag of 17 out-of-set tokens was my own regex catching the artifact's id slugs. All 15 Rosetta mentions are prohibitive. D-102 is quoted, not amended. OBL-2 not closed; no leftover-join invented. Cited digest and review clean; HEAD 5d5d778; required-now 26. Two observations: authorityClaim says a field 'is empty' where live v4 has no such field at all — true in substance, imprecise in form — and a few states lightly recast live wording without content drift.
